downloadedStarter.scope: Fresh public ZIP installation, production build, isolated standalone HTTP server, and exact sample-asset comparison. No application authentication or hosted-provider claim.

browser.scope: Independent headless Chrome and isolated Next standalone artifact; real PDF downloads, keyboard activation, narrow layouts. Existing authenticated browser sessions were not used.

scope: Published npm 0.2.0 with process isolation in the Next.js standalone starter. Three CI environments and a fresh downloadable ZIP install pass 17 HTTP/process/error-recovery checks. Real browser downloads match the retained invoice. No application authorization, hosted-provider, speed, or standards certification claim.
